Treatment summary
The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headaches
consistent with whiplash-type injury. The mechanism of injury is plausible for a collision of this nature. Over the
course of 13 visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, a home exercise
program, and posture education. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical
spine, with reduced range of motion and paraspinal msucle tenderness documented at initial evaluation. No prior
injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Treatment followed a usual and expected course, with visit
frequency tapering as symptoms steadily improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Billing records
reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At the time of discharge from
active care, the patient was improving and was instructed to continue the home exercise program as needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
